{{Short description|Brazilian physicist (1928–2021)}}
[[File:Palestra Sérgio Mascarenhas (7644938884).jpg|thumb|right|'''Sérgio Mascarenhas de Oliveira''', a noted [[Brazil]]ian experimental [[physicist]], [[educator]] and scientific leader]]
'''Sérgio Mascarenhas de Oliveira''' (May 2, 1928  — May 31, 2021<ref>[https://g1.globo.com/sp/sao-carlos-regiao/noticia/2021/06/01/morre-o-fisico-sergio-mascarenhas-fundador-da-ufscar-e-da-embrapa-de-sao-carlos.ghtml Morre o físico Sérgio Mascarenhas, fundador da UFSCar e da Embrapa de São Carlos] {{in lang|pt}}</ref>) was a Brazilian experimental [[physicist]], [[educator]] and scientific leader. He was awarded several prizes including the [[Brazilian Order of Scientific Merit]] in the categories of Commander<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.mctic.gov.br/mctic/opencms/legislacao/decretos/migracao/Decreto_de_02061995.html|title=MCTIC|website=www.mctic.gov.br|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref> and Great Cross,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.mctic.gov.br/mctic/opencms/legislacao/decretos/migracao/Decreto_de_05082002.html|title=MCTIC|website=www.mctic.gov.br|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref> the [[Conrado Wessel Prize]] for General Science,<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.fcw.org.br/v3/index.asp?pag=noticias&id=114&top=3&cat=2&subcat=2&nivel=2|title=Fundação Conrado Wessel - melhor visualizar em 1024x768|website=www.fcw.org.br|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref> the [[Joaquim da Costa Ribeiro Prize]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sbfisica.org.br/v1/home/index.php/pt/acontece/883-sergio-mascarenhas-ganha-premio-joaquim-da-costa-ribeiro-2019|title=Sérgio Mascarenhas ganha Prêmio Joaquim da Costa Ribeiro 2019|date=|website=www.sbfisica.org.br|language=pt-br|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref> and the [[Guggenheim Fellowship]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/all-fellows/sergio-mascarenhas-oliveira/|title=John Simon Guggenheim Foundation {{!}} Sergio Mascarenhas Oliveira|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-21}}</ref>

His main contributions to science were new observations of the [[thermo-dielectric effect]];<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/en/2007/07/01/sergio-mascarenhas/|title=Sérgio Mascarenhas: Physics in the current world {{!}} Revista Pesquisa Fapesp|website=revistapesquisa.fapesp.br|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref> the discovery of [[bioelectret]]s, i.e. [[electret]]s as a property of biological materials such as [[bone]] and [[biopolymer]]s, enabling the development of a new detector used in [[radiology|radiological]] [[dosimetry]] to date human bones in [[archeology|archeological]] sites;<ref>{{Citation|last=Mascarenhas|first=S.|chapter=Bioelectrets : Electrets in biomaterials and biopolymers|date=1987|pages=321–346|editor-last=Sessler|editor-first=Gerhard M.|series=Topics in Applied Physics|publisher=Springer Berlin Heidelberg|language=en|doi=10.1007/3540173358_14|isbn=9783540707509|title=Electrets|volume=33}}</ref> and the development of a [[non-invasive procedure]] to measure [[intracranial pressure]].<ref>{{Citation|title=Globonews {{!}} Especial inovação na saúde (legendado)|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=46y4p97c8e0|language=en|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://epocanegocios.globo.com/Caminhos-para-o-futuro/Saude/noticia/2018/10/ele-tem-90-anos-uma-startup-e-varios-projetos-pela-frente.html|title=Ele tem 90 anos, uma startup e vários projetos pela frente|website=vogue.globo.com|language=pt-br|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref>

Mascarenhas contributed to the creation of important Brazilian research institutions, such as the farming instrumentation center of the [[Brazilian Agricultural Research Corporation]] and the [[Federal University of São Carlos]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://g1.globo.com/sp/sao-carlos-regiao/noticia/2019/09/21/fundador-da-ufscar-e-da-embrapa-de-sao-carlos-sergio-mascarenhas-teme-o-futuro-da-ciencia-no-brasil.ghtml|title=Fundador da UFSCar e da Embrapa de São Carlos, Sérgio Mascarenhas teme o futuro da ciência no Brasil|website=G1|date=21 September 2019 |language=pt-br|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref>

== Early life==
Mascarenhas was born in [[Rio de Janeiro]], and obtained his degree in chemistry in 1951 from [[Federal University of Rio de Janeiro]] and in Physics in 1952 from the [[Rio de Janeiro State University]].

He was a visiting scholar in many universities around the world, including [[Carnegie Mellon University|Carnegie Mellon]], [[Princeton University|Princeton]], [[Harvard University|Harvard]], [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology|MIT]] and [[University of London]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sbpmat.org.br/en/gente-da-nossa-comunidade-entrevista-com-o-cientista-sergio-mascarenhas/|title=SBPMat´s community people: interview with the scientist Sergio Mascarenhas. – SBPMat – Sociedade Brasileira de Pesquisa em Materiais|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref>

== Federal University of São Carlos ==
Sérgio Mascarenhas played a major role in the establishment of the [[Federal University of São Carlos]]. Back in 1968, when the idea of creating the first federal university in São Paulo state came up, Mascarenhas proposed the creation of an innovative university instead of a traditional one<ref name=":0" /> (Mascarenhas had moved from Rio de Janeiro to São Carlos looking for more research opportunities in [[solid-state physics]]<ref>{{Citation|title=Especial com o cientista Sérgio Mascarenhas - Brasilianas.org episódio (26/03/2012)|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HJy3mMIhM_Y |archive-url=https://ghostarchive.org/varchive/youtube/20211215/HJy3mMIhM_Y |archive-date=2021-12-15 |url-status=live|language=en|access-date=2019-10-21}}{{cbignore}}</ref>). The Federal University of São Carlos was then established with that vision in mind and Mascarenhas was appointed the university's first [[Rector (academia)|rector]], where he helped to create the materials engineering degree, the first of its kind in Latin America.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://sema.dema.ufscar.br/ufscar_dema.html|title=SEMa|website=sema.dema.ufscar.br|access-date=2019-10-21}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sbpmat.org.br/en/20o-aniversario-da-criacao-do-instituto-de-fisica-de-sao-carlos-e-seis-decadas-participando-da-historia-da-pesquisa-em-materiais-no-brasil/|title=20th anniversary of the establishment of the São Carlos Institute of Physics, and six decades participating in the history of Materials research in Brazil. – SBPMat – Sociedade Brasileira de Pesquisa em Materiais|language=en-US|access-date=2019-10-22}}</ref>

He died in [[Ribeirão Preto]].
